content:
La lutte contre le doublement de la ligne ferroviaire continue de faire les choux-gras estivaux de la presse nationale. Après une manifestation historique le 25 juillet 2026 en marge de la 10

e

 édition du festival «

 

Alta Felicita

 

» à Venaus et du 15

e

 anniversaire de «

 

La République libre de la Maddalena

 

» qui s'est terminée par un joli saccage de divers chantiers dans la vallée de Suza, la répression s'est mis en branle afin de rassurer la compagnie

TELT

 (Tunnel Euralpin Lyon Turin) que les 1 millions d'euros de dégâts ne resteraient pas impunis.


 1 millions d'euros de dégâts et 4 camions de carabiniers en feu : une manif' contre le Lyon-Turin déterminée


 La marche annuelle contre le doublement du Lyon-Turin dans le Val de Suse ce week-end était particulièrement déterminée. En marge de la 10e édition du festival « Alta Felicita », 20 000 personnes se sont mobilisées contre la destruction en cours.


 29 juillet


L'internationale de la surveillance


En parcourant les journaux ce 13 août, on apprend en réalité que les ministères de l'Intérieur et les services de renseignement s'activaient en coulisse des deux côtés des Alpes bien en amont de la manifestation annoncée. La coopération franco-italienne s'est mise en place à partir du moment où les flics italiens ont alerté les services français de la forte probabilité que de nombreuses personnes traversent la frontières dans le but de participer à la manifestation. On apprend même plus précisément dans le Monde qu'un Français que les renseignements italiens ont placé dans leurs petites fiches comme proche des Soulèvements de la terre a été signalé par les Italiens aux Français qui ont mis en place une enquête administrative et une filature sur cette personne et son entourage. Sur la simple mention d'aller-retours à la frontière.


Petit à petit, le filet de la surveillance s'élargit alors même qu'on ne comprend pas bien quel cadre légal permet cette surveillance, outre la suspicion d'un déplacement prochain vers l'Italie. Ainsi, un groupe d'une dizaine de personnes est activement surveillé par les services de renseignement de la Préfecture de Paris qui les prend en photo et les filme abondamment, notamment pour tenter de déclencher une interpellation préventive. Les flics prétendent avec leurs images que le groupe se serait entraîné à lancer "ce qui ressemble à des engins explosifs" dans les anciens tunnels ferroviaires de la petite couronnne. Assez pour que les services de renseignements de Paris soient effrayés par ces "entraînements" qui constituerait selon eux la preuve de la préparation d'une action violente contre la ligne Lyon-Turin.


«

 

On a été traités comme un groupe terroriste

 

»


Le 23 juillet, soit donc deux jours avant la manifestation au départ de Venaus, huit personnes sont interpellées préventivement sur simples éléments de notes de surveillance de l'enquête administrative. Des persquisitions sont réalisées chez chacun·es des interpelé·es, leurs matériel informatique ainsi que leurs moyens de communication saisis. Le 27 juillet, les huit interpelé·es sont mis en examen pour pour “association de malfaiteurs, détention et transport de produits incendiaires en bande organisée”. Le parquet de Paris leur reproche notamment la détention de mortiers d'artifices, mais également de téléphones dédiés à la mobilisation et au déplacement en Italie.


Hier, mercredi 12 août, ils et elles ont toustes été relâchés après un passage à la chambre d'instruction de Paris, malgré l'insistance du parquet de les placer en détention provisoire, relatée par les journalistes présent·es. Iels sont placé·es sous contrôle judiciaire en attendant leur procès.


La lutte NoTAV face à la répression, une histoire ancienne


Comme Notre Dame des Landes ou encore Bure, la lutte No

TAV

, de par sa pérennité et son intensité, a été et est encore un laboratoire de la répression policière comme juridique, par les Etats italien et français. Elle a fait l'objet de violentes opérations policières — pour n'en citer qu'une, l'évacuation de l'occupation en 2011, pour laquelle l'État italien déploie 2 500 policiers et soldats et lance 4 000 grenades ­lacrymogènes sur les manifestantEs, provoque des centaines de blessé·es et une cinquantaine d'arrestations. À la suite de ces nombreuses actions de sabotage, ce territoire est déclaré «

 

zone militaire surveillée

 

» par la police et l'armée.

author: Sharon Zhang
title: Sanders Vows to Introduce Legislation to Stop Flock’s “AI Mass Surveillance”
content:
“You may not know it, but you may already be being tracked by artificial intelligence,” the senator said.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-Vermont) has pledged to introduce legislation aimed at reining in the mass adoption of AI-powered video surveillance via companies like Flock Safety, as the camera networks being erected in communities across the U.S. face fierce backlash.

Sanders said that the widespread adoption of AI-powered Flock cameras that monitor peoples’ every activity outside of their homes is edging the U.S. closer to a system of totalitarianism. The company says that its cameras are already in place in over 6,000 communities across the U.S.

“You may not know it, but you may already be being tracked by artificial intelligence,” Sanders wrote on Monday. “Flock, a surveillance company backed by Big Tech oligarchs like Marc Andreessen and Peter Thiel, has installed more than 120,000 AI-powered surveillance cameras across America.”

“What does that mean for you? It means that if Flock is in your community, every time you leave your house, a Flock camera records and tracks you,” Sanders went on. “If you are dropping your kids off at school, Flock knows. If you are going to a doctor, Flock knows. If you are going out on a date, Flock knows.”

Sanders said that he is soon introducing legislation to “stop Flock and AI mass surveillance.”

Flock cameras are marketed as tools that help policing with a network of automated license plate readers. The cameras work by recording video of cars passing by, then using an AI algorithm to add information like the make, model, and license plate details to its database about the vehicles. Police departments and other law enforcement agencies like Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) and Border Patrol can then use that data to track people and conduct arrests.

The company insists that their system “only captures vehicles,” and not information on individuals like biometric data. But reports have found that Flock’s technology goes far beyond just cars and license plates. The system also has the ability to identify and track individuals and their “associates” based on vehicles’ movement patterns, as well as personal information like their home addresses when used in combination with existing police databases.

When Sanders spoke out against the issue earlier this month, the company’s CEO, Garrett Langley, responded, saying that the cameras “do not track people’s every movement.”

However, there has been evidence in numerous cases showing that law enforcement officers are using Flock data to track individuals, even if it’s not capturing “every movement.” This includes cases in which police used the technology to stalk romantic interests, as well as cases where people were reportedly wrongly detained or jailed due to errors by the cameras. The cameras often get things wrong; for instance, according to the ACLU, Flock’s technology misidentifies the state that a license plate belongs to 10 percent of the time.

“Newer Flock cameras do not just record vehicles. They record people. Flock’s AI system can combine images of you and your vehicle with databases of phone numbers, relatives and court records to find out who you are, where you’re going and why,” Sanders explained. “We cannot allow America to become a surveillance state where a handful of AI oligarchs profit by giving the government the power to track our every movement.”

Sanders’s statements come amid backlash against the cameras in both major political parties. Senate Judiciary Subcommittee on Crime and Counterrorism chair Sen. Josh Hawley (R-Missouri) recently launched a probe into the extent of Flock’s data collection efforts.

Meanwhile, more than 100 cities and municipalities have cancelled or not renewed their contracts with Flock and other license plate reader companies since the beginning of 2025 — though some communities that have done so have reported that they are still being watched.

Truthout is funded almost entirely by readers — that’s why we can speak truth to power and cut against the mainstream narrative. But independent journalists at Truthout face mounting political repression under Trump.

We rely on your support to survive McCarthyist censorship. Please make a tax-deductible one-time or monthly donation.

title: Arkaş: Peace requires at least as much courage as war
content:
A commemoration for the Kurdish Freedom Movement’s martyrs was held in Nusaybin (Nisêbîn), in Mardin (Mêrdîn) province, under the leadership of MEBYA-DER (Association for Assistance, Solidarity, Unity and Culture of Families Who Have Lost Loved Ones in the Cradle of Civilizations).


The commemoration, held at the Covered Market Area next to the Şükrü Akay Condolence House at Hacılar Cemetery, was attended by families of those who had died, representatives of political parties and democratic mass organizations, as well as thousands of people from Nisêbîn and surrounding provinces and districts.


The crowd entered the commemoration area chanting “Bijî Serok Apo” and “Şehîd namirin” and accompanied by ululations, continuing the chants and applause throughout the event. Photographs of Abdullah Öcalan and fallen guerrillas were placed on the stage alongside roses and candles, while a large photograph of Öcalan was also hung at the site.


The program began with a minute of silence, followed by the singing of the “Çarxa Şoreşê” anthem.


Zeydan: Kurds are no longer those of a hundred years ago


Abdullah Zeydan, the co-mayor of Wan Metropolitan Municipality whose mandate was seized, stated that the Kurdish people had experienced severe repression and losses for many years.


Saying that Kurds have today established their existence before the world through their identity and language, Zeydan said, “Kurds are no longer the Kurds of a hundred years ago. Rojava is right next to us. Rojava was liberated under the leadership of women through the Leader’s philosophy of ‘Jin, Jiyan, Azadî.’”


Zeydan said they would continue the struggle of those who had died and would fight for Öcalan’s freedom.


Arkaş: Nusaybin is a city of resistance as well as suffering


Çetin Arkaş, a member of the Imralı Secretariat, drew attention to Nusaybin’s recent history and its history of resistance. Stating that the Kurdish people have experienced suffering and resistance together for three generations, Arkaş referred to the unsolved killings of the 1990s. Saying that Nusaybin should not be remembered only for its suffering, Arkaş noted that the city had also witnessed major acts of resistance.


Arkaş added: “Nusaybin is called a city of suffering, and that is true. But Nusaybin did not only experience suffering; it also witnessed great acts of heroism. We need to see this as a whole.”


The causes that brought about the use of arms must be eliminated


Assessing the Peace and Democratic Society Process, Arkaş said that the fact that the guns had been silent for nearly two years was positive. Arkaş continued: “The silencing of the guns alone does not mean peace. The resistance of three generations needs to be properly understood. The causes that brought about the use of arms must be eliminated. This is how peace becomes lasting.”


Stating that societies’ suffering should not be used against one another, Arkaş said: “Despite the suffering, we stand for peace. This people wants the guns to fall silent, but at the same time it wants the causes that brought about the use of arms to be eliminated.”


Arkaş said that “peace requires at least as much courage as war,” and added that the courage demonstrated during wartime must also be demonstrated during the peace process.


Stating that it is not enough merely to keep the names of those who died alive, Arkaş said that their understanding of freedom and justice must be passed on to future generations.


Şadiye Manap: The martyrs are our truth


Şadiye Manap, an activist with the Free Women’s Movement (TJA), also drew attention to Nisêbîn’s history of resistance. Stating that great sacrifices have been made in the city since the 1990s, Şadiye Manap said: “The sacrifices made for freedom are enormous. We are taking steps to build a new future. This process gives us strength.”

author: Nour Abo Aisha
title: Israel Restricts Cooking Gas Into Gaza, So We Must Burn Toxic Plastic to Cook
content:
The vile fumes saturate our food with their smell. Our daily inhalation of toxic burned plastics is slowly killing us.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

Before the ceasefire last year, Israel subjected Gaza to a comprehensive and enforced siege which prevented countless necessities from entering the Strip, including cooking gas. However, after the Witkoff Agreement was signed in October 2025, which contained a humanitarian clause allowing 600 trucks to enter daily, including 50 trucks designated for fuel and cooking gas, we Gazans believed that we would finally be able to use healthy and safe gas and that our suffering of looking for alternatives to cook would be over.

However, the Israeli occupation has implemented a policy of rationing and drastically reduced the number of gas trucks agreed upon, reducing this clause to mere ink on paper. These days, the “gas distribution cycle” is governed by a slow sequence where each family’s turn comes once every three months or according to what is permitted to pass in portions. Each time, a cylinder with just 8 kilograms of gas is purchased for 75 shekels, or $25. According to statements from the Gaza government’s media office cited by the Ultra Palestine (Ultrasawt) news site, Gaza baseline demand for cooking gas in normal conditions ranges between 400 and 500 tons of gas per day — this amount is needed to supply homes, bakeries, and hospitals. But the amount of cooking gas that actually enters Gaza currently does not exceed 120 tons — less than one-third of the minimum requirement for survival.

Now, almost three years after the October 7 War began, women in Gaza are compelled to order their children to gather plastic bags, water hoses from the debris of destroyed homes, used food wrappers, fabrics, and shoes to burn as fuel to prepare food. There is a total lack of firewood because of its excessive consumption and high prices. In order to cook, women are then forced to sit directly under the scorching sun next to tents and breathe the rising toxic emissions of these materials, which has led to serious health, psychological, and respiratory issues. Their bodies are exposed to harm every day from the inhalation of toxins, amid the severe psychological disorders resulting from the inevitable comparison between the pleasures of life before the war and the tragedy experienced today.

I can’t remember how many times I told my mother, “I’m suffocating in every sense of the word, and if I don’t die by bombing, these deadly gases will kill me,” while she lit fires and positioned plastic hoses beneath the crude stove to make lunch. The toxins saturate the food itself with their smell, which makes food a means to survive, not something to enjoy.

“I’m suffocating in every sense of the word, and if I don’t die by bombing, these deadly gases will kill me.”

My mom can’t cook with gas every day without depleting the cylinder in two weeks, so we will remain waiting for our turn on the list for two full months. In winter I never could succeed in lighting the fire for the stove, which was always going out, and I would say to myself in regret: “Why am I doomed to all this suffering merely for the purpose of warming a little water to bathe in?”

However, as I heard women’s testimonies in the tents, I became aware that my small grievances had become less significant in comparison to their suffering. Many women’s worn-out bodies are engaged in a vicious physical battle as a result of the lack of cooking gas, which is more than just an extra hardship in the day’s details.

Shadia Mahdi, 40 years old, is a witness to the “deadly trade-off” policy that imposes forced survival in one of the displacement tents in northwest Gaza. In the absence of free medical care, Shadia, who battles cancer tumors in the intestines and glands and suffers from diabetes and high blood pressure, had to sell her family’s gas cylinder in order to pay for treatment.

Shadia said with exhaustion, “I have been without a single drop of gas for more than 50 days.” After selling the gas cylinder for an insulin dose to keep herself alive, Shadia was left with no choice but to gather used clothing materials, ribbons, and plastic shoes in order to build a fire for preparing food.

Daily inhalation of fumes and burned plastics transforms our makeshift stoves into slow execution chambers.

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "The Lion King" in Quechua?: New Film "Runa Simi" Profiles Indigenous Artist Keeping Language Alive
content:
Experts estimate that a language is lost every two weeks — and that half of the world’s 7,000 spoken languages could be lost by the end of the century. Quechua is the most widely spoken Indigenous language in the Americas, with approximately 7 to 10 million speakers living primarily in Peru, Bolivia and Ecuador. But like so many Indigenous languages, Qechua is vulnerable due to cultural pressures and discrimination.


The new documentary

Runa Simi

 — “our language” in Quechua — follows Fernando Valencia, a Peruvian voice actor, Indigenous activist, radio host and single father, who has dubbed many online clips of animated movies into Quechua from his home in Cusco, Peru. In the film, Fernando pursues his most ambitious goal yet: to fully dub Disney’s animated classic

The Lion King

 into Quechua, with the help of his 8-year-old son, Dylan.


“I am sharing our culture to the worldwide culture,” says Fernando Valencia, who started dubbing films after noticing that Quechua-speaking Indigenous children were watching movies dubbed into Spanish that they couldn’t understand.


“There’s like one hour a week of Quechua [in school], so it is very hard to actually learn it,” says Fernando’s son Dylan, who is now 14 years old.


“Indigenous people in Peru are fighting for basic rights, like having water, electricity, healthcare, education in their own language,” says Augusto Zegarra, the director of

Runa Simi

. “But they also have the right to access entertainment in their own language.”

author: antimilitarismus
title: She for Him: Ukraine’s Women Leading the Resistance to “Busification” – Marta Havryshko
content:
As the state hunts for soldiers, women in Ukraine are fighting to keep their men from the front.

/ Česky / Românesc / Français / Ελληνικά / Español / Italiano / Русский / український / Magyar /

In recent days, an image of a young woman in Kamianske, in Ukraine’s Dnipropetrovsk region, has ricocheted across social media. She is on her knees before a military recruitment officer, her hands clasped as if in prayer. Her face is a portrait of fear and desperation. His appears impassive.

Her plea could not be simpler: do not take her husband to war.

A woman on her knees, pleading with draft officers not to mobilize her husband and send him to war. Kamianske, Dnipropetrovsk oblast. 2026.

But the officer seems unmoved. He has a quota to meet, and it collides head-on with her desperate appeal. The army needs bodies. Tears and pleas from women on their knees do not figure into that calculus. If anything, they have become an inconvenience.

Today, this woman embodies more than a Ukraine wounded by war—a country bleeding and increasingly desperate for the violence to end. She has also become a symbol of resistance to coercive mobilization, a phenomenon roiling Ukraine in the fifth year of the full-scale war and one that President Volodymyr Zelenskyy’s government can no longer easily keep from Western view, despite carefully cultivated narratives of Ukrainian resilience and a willingness to endure the war for “as long as it takes.”

Women are increasingly at the forefront of that resistance.

In Ukraine, coercive street mobilization has acquired its own bitter piece of slang: “busification”—a reference to cases in which military recruitment officers are accused of forcibly pushing or dragging military-age men into vans in public places.

Across videos circulating on Ukrainian social media, women of every generation can be seen intervening as men are confronted by recruitment officers. They film alleged abuses. They publicly shame recruiters for violent conduct. They plead with them to spare husbands, sons, brothers and strangers. And when pleading fails, some fight back—with fists, handbags, shovels, stones, whatever happens to be within reach.

Others shelter men inside their homes, shops and workplaces, blocking recruitment officers from entering and refusing to surrender those hiding inside.

Women have become the face of resistance to busification.

First, women are the primary witnesses to busification.

Ukraine’s streets have increasingly become a female domain. Public transportation can at times resemble a gender-segregated space: the few men aboard might be the driver, an elderly grandfather on his way to yet another doctor’s appointment, or a carefree student still too young to face the draft. Everyone else is a woman.

Women are everywhere because, unlike military-age men, they can still move around the country with relative freedom—without the same fear of being stopped by men in uniform and forced into a minibus. Most women are not subject to compulsory military service. Although roughly 75,000 Ukrainian women serve in Ukraine’s Armed Forces, for most of them military service remains a choice. For men, it is an obligation.

Women fend off draft officers trying to seize a man in Lviv, 2025.

That wartime privilege gives women something increasingly precious in Ukraine: freedom of movement.

And that is precisely why women so often become the first witnesses to episodes of busification—and the first to run to a man’s defense.

Second, women are protecting the men they love.

Their sons. Their husbands. Their brothers. Their partners.

They throw themselves at recruitment officers with the ferocity of animals defending their young from a predator. Mothers shield their sons with their own bodies. Wives wail in the middle of the street as their husbands are bundled into vans, as though they were watching them being carried away to certain death.

Some are so desperate that even pregnancy does not stop them from physically intervening to keep their husbands from being sent to the front.

Others organize. They gather outside Territorial Recruitment Centers and plead for their men to be released. Or rather, they no longer plead. They demand.

“We demand that our men be released! Let fathers return to their children. Return sons to their mothers, and husbands to their wives. We demand an end to these bandit-style abductions of men into captivity.”

That was the message of women who gathered outside a Territorial …

author: PETA-Team
title: Erfolg: Emma Matratzen beendet Zusammenarbeit mit HKTVmall
content:
Seit 2022 finanziert die Hong Kong Technology Venture Company Limited (HKTV) dutzende tödliche

Tierversuche

: Dabei werden Schweinen und Schafen in Experimenten Gliedmaßen und ihre Köpfe abgetrennt. Das Unternehmen ist die Muttergesellschaft von HKTVmall, einer der bekanntesten Online-Shopping-Plattformen Hongkongs.


Mit den Experimenten soll Technologie entwickelt werden, um Organe von Tieren für eine mögliche

Transplantation in Menschen

 zu nutzen. Dabei räumt HKTV selbst ein, dass die Versuche in hohem Maße spekulativ seien und es „keine Garantie“ für einen künftigen Nutzen für Menschen gebe.[1]


PETA USA und PETA Asien machen seit Frühjahr 2026 mit Protesten, Gesprächen mit Geschäftspartnern und weiteren Aktionen Druck auf HKTV. Die Kampagne zeigt Wirkung: Mehrere Unternehmen haben ihre Zusammenarbeit mit HKTVmall beendet oder angekündigt, dies zu tun. Im August 2026 kam mit dem deutschen, international agierenden Matratzenhersteller Emma ein weiteres großes Unternehmen hinzu.


Erfolg nach PETA-Gesprächen: Emma beendet Zusammenarbeit mit HKTVmall


Im August 2026 gab der Matratzenhersteller Emma bekannt, seinen Onlineshop auf HKTVmall bis Ende des Jahres zu schließen und die Geschäftsbeziehung vollständig zu beenden. Zuvor hatte PETA das Unternehmen darüber informiert, dass die Muttergesellschaft von HKTVmall tödliche Experimente an Schweinen und Schafen finanziert. 


Damit reiht sich Emma in eine wachsende Zahl von Unternehmen ein, die nach Bekanntwerden der Tierversuche Konsequenzen gezogen haben. Nach Beendigung der Geschäftsbeziehung sollen auch keine Provisionen oder Gebühren von Emma mehr an die Shopping-Plattform fließen. 


Die Emma

 Matratzen GmbH

 erklärte zu der Entscheidung: 


„Bei Emma wissen wir, dass guter Schlaf auch bedeutet, ein reines Gewissen zu haben. Sobald wir von den besorgniserregenden Tierversuchen erfahren haben, die von der Muttergesellschaft von HKTVmall finanziert werden, haben wir entschieden, unsere Geschäftsbeziehung mit HKTVmall nicht fortzusetzen. Der Shop wird geschlossen und die Geschäftsbeziehung bis Ende des Jahres vollständig beendet. Wir schätzen und unterstützen es, dass PETA uns darauf aufmerksam gemacht hat.“ 

Emma Matratzen GmbH

 


Weitere Unternehmen beenden Zusammenarbeit mit HKTVmall


Emma ist nicht das erste Unternehmen, das die Zusammenarbeit mit HKTVmall wegen der Tierversuche beendet. Bereits im Frühjahr 2026 hatten mindestens drei weitere Unternehmen öffentlich Konsequenzen gezogen: 


das Kosmetikunternehmen Lush Asia Limited, 


das Unternehmen für Gesundheitsprodukte für tierische Mitbewohner Pawfect Reborn, 


der Essenslieferdienst Fitasty. 


Lush Asia Limited begründete seinen Rückzug ausdrücklich mit Bedenken wegen der Tierversuche innerhalb der Unternehmensgruppe. Das Unternehmen erklärte, auch eine indirekte finanzielle Unterstützung solcher Experimente vermeiden zu wollen. 


Die Reaktionen zeigen: Öffentlicher Druck und die direkte Ansprache von Geschäftspartnern können konkrete Veränderungen bewirken.


Was passiert bei den von HKTV finanzierten Tierversuchen? 


Nach Informationen von PETA USA und PETA Asien finanziert HKTV seit 2022 dutzende Experimente, bei denen Schweine und Schafe verstümmelt und getötet werden. Dabei werden den Tieren unter anderem ihre Gliedmaßen und Köpfe abgetrennt.


Mit den Versuchen sollen Technologien für Organtransplantationen entwickelt werden. Organe von Tieren sollen dabei auf ihre Eignung für eine mögliche Transplantation in Menschen untersucht werden.


Wir von PETA Deutschland und unsere internationalen Partnerorganisationen kritisieren diese Experimente nicht nur aus

ethischen Gründen

. Es stehen auch

tierversuchsfreie Methoden

 zur Verfügung, um menschliche Gesundheit, Organerhaltung, Geweberegeneration und Transplantationsverfahren zu untersuchen.


PETA USA und PETA Asien fordern das Unternehmen daher auf, die Finanzierung der Tierversuche unverzüglich zu beenden und auf tierfreie Methoden umzusteigen.


April 2026: Proteste und erste Unternehmen wenden sich von HKTVmall ab 


Im April 2026 wandte sich PETA Asien schriftlich an die Unternehmensleitung und forderte ein sofortiges Ende der Experimente. 


Auch vor der Zentrale von HKTVmall machten Aktive auf das Leid der Tiere aufmerksam. Bei einer Protestaktion trugen sie blutverschmierte Overalls sowie übergroße Schweine- und Schafsmasken. Mit symbolischen Tierköpfen, einer riesigen Spritze und einem blutverschmierten Messer …

author: webadmin
title: Shut Down The Stowe School Beagles!
content:
Today the Hunt Saboteurs Association can exclusively reveal the full footage that led to the recent conviction of Stowe School Beagles Kennel Huntsman Philip Kennedy for killing a hare in November 2025.


This is the first step in our campaign to shut down this hunt.


The footage shows both the extent of the cruelty of the Stowe School Beagles and the catastrophic failure of safeguarding at the £47,000 per year school.


Unbelievably, Kennedy is employed as a ‘Games Coach’ at Stowe and the hare hunting shown in the video is essentially a PE lesson, just like the rugby and hockey that is also offered at the school.


The Stowe School Beagles pursue the hare across a car park.


As the video opens, unsupervised Stowe pupils are looking for hares in the open Northamptonshire countryside. On their return to Crockwell Farm, the hounds are put into a strip of woodland by the farm’s car park. The hunters are there for some time – they obviously know a hare is present – before the hounds flush the terrified animal out across the car park.


Huntsman pats hounds as they rip into the hare.


The pursuit continues through a larger wood, with Kennedy positioning himself on its far side in case the hare breaks cover. The video next picks up the last moments of the doomed animal: she sprints across open ground – closely pursued by the whole pack – before crashing into a fence. She is obviously gravely injured but limps on before being overwhelmed by the pack.


Handshakes all round as the hare is ragged by the hounds.


The hunters arrive on the scene, patting the hounds and exchanging congratulatory handshakes as the hare is ripped to pieces. Back at the hound van and Stowe School minibus, the celebrations continue.


With the hare hunting season about to begin we cannot allow this cruelty to continue: the HSA will shortly be asking you – our valued supporters – to take action.

Please keep an eye on our socials over the next few days.

author: A.N.A.
title: [Itália] Antiespecismo, veganismo e crise climática
content:
O verão que estamos vivendo está nos mostrando de forma tremendamente tangível o quanto nossas atividades destrutivas estão impactando o clima terrestre. Não há parte do mundo que não esteja sofrendo com desconfortos, ou mesmo verdadeiros desastres, climáticos. Em nosso país, ondas de calor tropical se sucedem, causando cada vez mais incêndios (quando não são criminosos), eventos climáticos extremos e fazendo diminuir assustadoramente o nível da água dos rios e lagos.


Nossa casa comum, a Terra, está doente e o vírus que a infectou somos nós.

 Um conceito mais que banal e totalmente evidente. Apesar de tudo isso, no âmbito antiespecista e vegano, este assunto tão dramaticamente urgente quase nunca é abordado. No entanto, toda vez que uma floresta pega fogo, morrem milhões de Animais, assim como também ocorre com deslizamentos, enxurradas, alagamentos, transbordamentos, longos períodos de seca e tempestades. As zonas climáticas estão mudando rapidamente e isso também significa o desaparecimento de muitas espécies animais que não conseguirão mais se adaptar ao novo clima. Como é que não paramos para refletir sobre tudo isso?


A 

Questão Animal

 diz respeito a todas as áreas da ação humana, a todas as suas implicações e consequências, portanto, também e principalmente, aos desastres climáticos que estamos causando com a poluição, o enorme desperdício de energia, as atividades extrativistas, a poluição, a exploração dos ecossistemas e a antropização e destruição dos habitats naturais. Não considerar tudo isso sob uma ótica antiespecista e vegana, para tentar combater este fenômeno gravíssimo e complexo que produzimos diretamente, é simplesmente uma loucura.


Se a nossa função, enquanto pessoas humanas antiespecistas, é retirar os Animais da exploração humana e, por fim, chegar à tão almejada libertação, não podemos nos eximir de compreender o quanto a crise climática está impactando de forma devastadora a vida dos seres vivos terrestres.


Cada vez mais, a mídia nos mostra imagens de rios secos; toda vez que um rio desaparece, deixando apenas um leito vazio e seco, desaparecem também milhões de Animais, plantas, muitos outros organismos vivos que o habitavam e outros que dependiam de sua presença: quando um rio morre, com ele morre um mundo inteiro, é um grande e vital amigo que se foi. Não podemos ser tão estúpidos e insensíveis a ponto de não compreender isso.


Temos o dever e a urgência de incluir no leque de reflexões e intervenções do nosso ativismo conceitos básicos de ecologia: certamente não aquela especista, antropocêntrica e superficial que nos é empurrada diariamente, mas a 

ecologia profunda

 não antropocêntrica, útil para nos ajudar finalmente a entender o quão frágil e ameaçada está a rede da vida na Terra.


Adriano Fragano

title: 1,500 mink escape from Oregon farm after fence is cut open reportedly by extremist animal rights group
content:
Roughly 1,500 mink escaped an Oregon farm after a hole was cut in a fence — with an extremist animal rights group linking themselves to the plot to free the creatures, according to authorities and reports.

The scores of mink were intentionally let loose from Cascade Farm in Turner late last Wednesday night as the farm’s manager, his wife, children, and other employees were sleeping, KOIN reported.

The suspected intruders cut a hole in a chain-link fence enclosure, allowing the mink to roam free, the local outlet said.

The Animal Liberation Front — a decentralized group of international animal rights advocates labeled as extremists by the FBI — appears to have taken responsibility for the break-in, the outlet reported.

In a press release, the radical group said they have yet to receive an “anonymous communique” officially taking credit for the action.

But Jerry Vlasak, a spokesperson for the North American Animal Liberation Front, told the outlet that the mink escape plot was consistent with their group’s actions and that communiques from activists claiming responsibility are not always sent.

The farm owners have since recovered about 90% of the cute, semiaquatic mammals, the Marion County Sheriff’s Office told the outlet.

“This wasn’t activism. It was a criminal act against a legally operated, certified farm,” Challis Hobbs, Executive Director of Fur Commission USA, an organization that represents mink farmers including Cascade Farm, told the outlet.

“The farm manager and his wife and children live on this property, along with other employees and their families,” he said. “It’s deeply unsettling to have people cut through a fence in the middle of the night with children sleeping just steps away.”

Cascade Farm raises mink legally for pelts and is Humane Care Certified. Any of the mink that aren’t recovered within 24 to 48 hours also face risk of starvation and death, Fur Commission USA added.

The animal activists, however, claimed the mink would be subjected to “egregiously cruel and violent” treatment in captivity.

“The animals liberated last night have a fighting chance at life; they faced a 100 percent death rate if they stayed on the farm,” the Animal Liberation Front wrote in a statement.

The group previously claimed responsibility for cutting open a fence at Olsen Fur Farm in Wisconsin in 2023, allowing about 3,000 mink to escape, CBS reported.

: https://warzonedistro.noblogs.org/post/2026/05/07/vegan-amorality-an-egoist-nihilist-critique-of-speciesism/


WHY THE SYSTEM NEEDS VEGANISM TO BE MORALITY


 The system needs veganism to be framed as morality because morality can be dismissed. Morality can be debated. Morality can be subjected to philosophical scrutiny and found wanting. Morality can be relativized, complicated, and ultimately neutralized. But refusal cannot be dismissed. Refusal is not a claim about objective moral facts. It is a withdrawal of consent. And the withdrawal of consent does not require justification. It requires only the recognition that one is participating in something and the decision to stop participating.


 This is why the conversation always shifts to morality. When someone says, “I don’t eat animals,” the response is almost never, “What do you know about animal agriculture that makes you refuse to participate?” The response is, “Why do you think it’s morally wrong to eat animals?” The shift is immediate and automatic. The refusal is transformed into a moral claim, and once it is a moral claim, it can be subjected to all the rhetorical moves that neutralize moral arguments.


 But the refusal is not a moral claim. The refusal is a pragmatic recognition that animal agriculture is a system of domination and a decision to withdraw consent from participation in that system. This recognition does not depend on moral realism. It depends on observation. And the decision does not depend on moral duty. It depends on one’s own judgment about what one is willing to participate in.


 The system cannot allow this understanding to take hold. Because if veganism were understood as refusal rather than morality, it could not be dismissed on metaethical grounds. It could not be neutralized by appeals to moral complexity, moral relativism, moral imperfection, or moral priorities. It could only be confronted on its own terms: as a withdrawal of consent from a system of domination. And this confrontation would require the system to justify itself—to explain why the domination is legitimate, why the killing is necessary, why the consumer should consent to participate.


 The system cannot provide this justification. So it ensures that the question is never asked. It ensures that veganism is always framed as morality, always subjected to moral scrutiny, always dismissed on moral grounds. The framing is not accidental. It is strategic. It is the primary mechanism by which the system protects itself from examination.


 This is why the metaethical distinction is the key. Once you understand that veganism is not morality—that it is ethics, that it is refusal, that it is Negation, that it is the withdrawal of consent from domination—the entire landscape changes. The rhetorical moves that neutralize moral arguments no longer apply. The demand for moral justification is revealed as illegitimate. And, again, the question becomes: What does this system do, and do I consent to participate in it?


EGOISM AND THE DESTRUCTION OF “SPOOKS”


“I also love human beings, not just a few individuals, but every one. But I love them with the awareness of egoism; I love them because love makes me happy, I love because love is natural to me, it pleases me. I know no ‘commandment of love.’ I have fellow-feeling with every feeling being, and their torment torments me, their refreshment refreshes me too; I can kill, not torture, them.” — Max Stirner


 Max Stirner, in The Unique and Its Property, introduced the concept of the “spook”—an abstract ideal, a concept, a fixed idea, a value that people treat as if it were real and binding, even though it exists only in their minds. Morality, in Stirner’s analysis, is the ultimate spook. It is a phantom that people sacrifice themselves to, that prevents them from recognizing their own will as the only legitimate source of action.


 For Stirner, the only thing that matters is the ego—not in the petty, mean-spirited sense of selfishness, but in the sense of self-ownership, of your own will as the measure of your actions. And crucially: other egos matter too, not because morality demands it, but because you encounter them, they are real, and your power is always exercised in relation to them. title: Der Bauernverband gibt der Ernährungsinitiative recht
content:
Am 27. September 2026 können die Stimmberechtigten der Schweiz über die Ernährungsinitiative abstimmen.


Hier meine persönliche Meinung zu dieser Initiative: diese Initiative möchte, dass der Anteil in der Schweiz produzierter und konsumierter pflanzlicher Lebensmittel steigt und schlägt vor, über die Förderung des Anbaus und des Konsums solcher Lebensmittel einen Selbstversorgungsgrad von 70% anzustreben.


Das ist ein sinnvolles Anliegen, das sich für eine ressourceneffizientere und somit nachhaltigere Landwirtschaft einsetzt: aktuell wird in der Schweiz auf Ackerland viel Tierfutter angebaut in Form von Futtermais, Futtergetreide und Futterrüben. Es wäre viel sinnvoller und effizienter auf diesen Flächen stattdessen Lebensmittel für die menschliche Ernährung anzubauen. Erst recht da wir in der Schweiz eine Unterversorgung haben an Getreide und Leguminosen für die menschliche Ernährung und diese im grossen Stil importieren, während bei tierischen Produkten teilweise gar grosse Mengen exportiert werden müssen, weil in der Schweiz die Nachfrage nicht genügt.


Obwohl das Anliegen der Initiative vernünftig und nachhaltig ist, macht die Gegnerschaft schon seit geraumer Zeit mit absurden Parolen wie «Nein zum Veganzwang!» Stimmung gegen diese Initiative. Und sie macht das so erfolgreich, dass inzwischen sogar der Umweltverband Pro Natura, welcher die Initiative anfangs unterstützte, wohl aus Angst vor einem Imageschaden die Nein-Parole beschlossen hat. Ein sehr bemerkenswerter Vorgang bei einem ökologischen Anliegen.


Trotz der reisserischen Parolen lohnt es sich, die Argumente der Gegnerschaft genauer anzuschauen: Unter dem Titel vom «Veganzwang» argumentiert der Bauernverband, dass ein Selbstversorgungsgrad von 70% nur durch eine vegane oder nahezu vegane Ernährung möglich wäre. Ja, richtig gelesen: der Bauernverband sagt, dass durch vegane Ernährung ein höherer Selbstversorgungsgrad möglich wäre. Das ist eine wilde 180°-Wende zu pflanzenbasierter Ernährung: von Verteidiger:innen der Nutztierhaltung hiess es bis anhin fast durchs Band, dass vegane Ernährung in der Schweiz keinen Sinn mache, da aufgrund des Grünlandes in der Schweiz bei einem höheren Anteil pflanzlicher Ernährung der Selbstversorgungsgrad sinken würde. Nun bestätigt also der Bauernverband, dass mit einem höheren Anteil pflanzlicher Lebensmittel ein höherer Selbstversorgungsgrad möglich wäre. Er bestätigt damit auch, dass die aktuelle Schweizer Landwirtschaft in hohem Mass Ressourcenverschwendung betreibt. Und er gibt damit inhaltlich auch der Initiative Recht: mit mehr pflanzlichen Lebensmitteln wäre ein höherer Selbstversorgungsgrad und eine ressourceneffizientere Landwirtschaft möglich.


Das einzige, was der Bauernverband gegen die Initiative sagt, ist also, dass er das nicht möchte. Er möchte lieber die aktuellen verschwenderischen landwirtschaftlichen Förderstrukturen beibehalten, anstatt den Anbau von pflanzlichen Lebensmitteln zu fördern, die nachhaltiger wären und für die es in der Schweiz tatsächlich einen Bedarf und eine Nachfrage gäbe.


Dass der Bauernverband trotz dem offenen Eingestehen, dass ihre Landwirtschaft nicht nachhaltig ist, die Stimmung so prägen kann, dass selbst Pro Natura einknickt, sollte zu denken geben. Und zeigt meiner Meinung nach zwei Dinge: erstens welche Diskursmacht der eng mit den Wirtschaftsverbänden verbundene Bauernverband bei Landwirtschaftsthemen bis weit in linke und ökologische Kreise hinein hat. Und zweitens welch überhöhte, romantisierte und unantastbare Stellung die Tierhaltung und insbesondere die Rinderhaltung in der Schweizer Öffentlichkeit hat.


Darum umso dringender: JA am 27.9.26 zur Ernährungsinitiative!


Jann Krättli, Biohof Tannacker, Rechthalten

Der Bauernverband gibt der Ernährungsinitiative recht

Tier im Fokus (TIF)

title: Leveret Hunting Underway Across The Country
content:
The recent conviction of packs such as the Stowe School Beagles, the Pipewell Foot Beagles and the Dorset & Somerset Bassets have highlighted the ongoing issue of illegal hare hunting.


But far from being deterred by their paltry fines, these and other packs will shortly be beginning their programme of illegal leveret hunting.


Low key: beaglers head out into the killing fields.


What Is Leveret Hunting?


As with fox hunting, beagles must be trained to hunt and kill their quarry. Leverets – young hares – present an easy target for the new and inexperienced hounds. The pack of beagles are taken to open fields and encouraged to search for hares and leverets. Unlike in main season hunting, the hunters do not want a long chase. They will even turn escaping leverets back towards the hounds to ensure a quick kill.


Leveret hunting usually takes place in September and early October but can start as soon as crops are cleared. The hunters meet early in the morning – from 6am onwards – because that is when the scent is best for new, inexperienced hounds and because the countryside is very quiet.


The Sandhurst & Aldershot Beagles keep a low profile.


“The Hare Hunters Equivalent of Cub Hunting”


Fox hunters have tried to rebrand their cub hunting as ’autumn’ hunting. However, beaglers recognise that hunting young hares is so horrendous that they simply deny it exists. A brief look at their literature – from the days when they were a little more open and honest – reveals otherwise:


“…young hounds should be allowed to get away on a well-grown leveret rather than an old, experienced hare.” –

‘Early Hunting Lessons’ chapter in ‘Beagling’ by J.C. Jeremy Hobson.


“…hounds are taken out in the early morning or late afternoon. This is for the hare hunters equivalent of cub hunting; some masters, in fact, call the period “leveret hunting.” –

‘Hunts and Countries’ chapter in ‘Beaglers’ by Jack Ivester Lloyd


“In order to get young hounds trained to hunt they start hunting in the very early morning or evening once the harvest is clear usually in August or September. They are accompanied only by invitation of the Master for this beagling equivalent of the foxhunter’s cub-hunting.” –

An Introduction To Beagling by Iain Clarke.


Typical leveret hunt meet: note hound trailer to the left.


What does it look like?


Obviously, a pack of small beagle hounds in the middle of a field is a give-away. There will be few people present as only the most trusted supporters are invited to attend these secret hunts. Don’t expect the hunters to be in uniform – they don’t usually wear this until the main season.


Stowe School Beaglers congratulate each other after tearing a hare to pieces.


What should I do if I see a suspected leveret hunt?


If it is safe to do so, filming the hunters will often be enough to stop them in their tracks. Try to film key individuals and their vehicles. Please then pass this information to the Hunt Saboteurs Association tip-off line on:

07443 148426

.


Hunting leverets with dogs is illegal so, if you believe a crime is in progress, call the police straight away.

title: ‘They’re still there’: Activists warn of more mink raids after break-in at Oregon farm
content:
PORTLAND, Ore. (KOIN) — After a late-night break-in last week led to the escape of 1,500 mink from an Oregon farm, some animal rights activists say more intrusions could be on the way.

The Animal Liberation Front, a decentralized group of extremist animal rights advocates known for sabotage, vandalism and even arson, has claimed responsibility in a press release shared on its website for the Aug. 13 break-in at Cascade Farms of Oregon mink farm in Turner, Oregon.

That claim has been unconfirmed by officials. The Federal Bureau of Investigation’s Portland office declined to comment on whether it is investigating the break-in.

The Marion County Sheriff’s Office said there have been no arrests related to the case, and they have no information indicating the ALF’s involvement.

The owner of Cascade Farms of Oregon, Randy Lucas, did not respond to multiple phone calls seeking comment about the break-in. Cascade Farms was established by Lucas’ father, John Lucas, as a meat business and ranch in 1980. The meat business has since closed, and John Lucas passed away, but the ranch remains in business.

But Joseph Buddenberg, a former member of the Animal Liberation Front, said the break-in at Cascade Farm in Turner is consistent with an ALF action. Jerry Vlasak from the North American Animal Liberation press office, which represents the ALF in North America, also said it was consistent with an ALF action but has not received an anonymous communique taking credit for the action. Vlasak also said communiques are often submitted by activists days or even weeks after an event but sometimes aren’t sent at all.

“There have been over 100 fur farm raids in the United States dating back to the 1990s,” Buddenberg said. “Cutting the fences, opening cages, and destroying breeding records have been tactics historically utilized by the ALF.”

Buddenberg pleaded guilty in 2016 to conspiracy to violate the Animal Enterprise Terrorism Act after he and a partner were accused of terrorizing the fur industry during cross-country road trips. He has since completed his sentence and said he hopes speaking out can help people understand why activists go to such extreme lengths.

“Every summer we see activists break in to free mink from farms,” he said. “Every November, they’re pelted.”

Farmed mink are typically bred and raised early in the year until around November, when they’re harvested for their pelts, which are sold for luxury fur apparel and other items. The industry generated $28.1 million in pelts in 2024, according to the U.S. Department of Agriculture’s Mink Survey.

Humanely certified operations use carbon monoxide gas, which immediately renders them unconscious and ensures they die quickly and without pain, according to the trade organization Fur Commission USA. The group estimates there are approximately 275 mink farms in 23 states across the U.S., and has said mink that are released often don’t survive.

“If they stayed on the farm, they’d have a 100% death rate,” he said. “Release at least gives them a chance at survival. Fur farmers should definitely expect to see more of this before November.”

Despite his previous felony conviction and time served, Buddenberg remains steadfast in his views.

“Opening cages and freeing these animals is the most compassionate thing you can do,” he said. “My mind hasn’t changed on that at all.”

Oregon’s mink farming industry is a shadow of what it once was. Data from the U.S. Department of Agriculture show Oregon had 37 mink farms in 1978. A decade later, in 1998, that number dropped to 30. By 2006, there were only 18 mink farms in Oregon. Since then, the USDA has stopped including the number of ranches in its reports. Some estimates say Oregon currently has around 11 mink farms. Others, including Buddenberg, estimate there are only about five left in the state, including Cascade.

“Actions like this have a history of closing fur farms,” Buddenberg said. “My hope is that this farm will close. Actions like this are very effective.”

The ALF claimed responsibility for multiple mink farm break-ins in Oregon in 2008, according to several reports published in the Oregonian and the Daily Astorian. They included a break-in at Jefferson Mink Farm in Jefferson, a break-in at S&N Fur Farm in Scio, and a break-in at Ylipelto’s Fur Farm in Astoria. In all three cases, fencing around the farm was cut, and the mink were released into the wild.

title: Hunting: It’s No Child’s Play
content:
In 2023, the UN released General Comment No. 26. This document updates the famous UN Convention on the Rights of the Child. It explicitly states children must be kept safe from witnessing violence, including physical or psychological harm inflicted on animals. Yet every week across the UK children are taken out to participate in hunting, where they will be exposed to horrific levels of animal cruelty.


A small child is witness to a fox being dug out and thrown to waiting hounds.


On Boxing Day 2020 the Avon Vale Hunt were filmed digging out a fox and throwing her to waiting hounds. Tom Ledbury, the terrierman for this hunt, was sentenced to a 12-month community order for his role in this sickening act. Something equally horrifying is how a small child was present throughout the dig out.


Recent HSA articles have exposed the extent of indoctrination of children into the world of hunting. One of the most recent exposes is the

Stowe Beagles

 recent conviction for killing a hare. Kennel huntsman Philip Kennedy was convicted for the offence but drone footage shows students from Stowe School gloating and celebrating while the hare is mauled by hounds.


Is it part of Stowe Schools curriculum to encourage students to participate in the tearing apart of wildlife?


In November 2025 Lake District Hunt Sabs caught the horrifying moment the

Coniston Foxhounds

 dug out a fox with the use of a terrier, and carried her to waiting hounds. What is apparent from the footage is how co-ordinated the dig out was, a clear indication that this is a regular occurrence. What is also evident are the ages of some of the participants. While older members of the group are participating in the dig out, younger members are watching closely, enthusiastically waiting to get involved, with one of them being handed the terrified fox who he then carries and throws to hounds.


This youth gleefully grabbed the fox by the scruff of her neck and threw her to hounds.


As we know, animal cruelty is just one part of a hunt, there is much more anti-social behaviour and illegal activity that comes with it and this doesn’t stop just because a hunt is professing to have a children’s meet.


In February this year West Midlands Hunt Saboteurs reported of road chaos and violence at a Warwickshire Hunt children’s meet. While hunting in Little Kineton gamekeeper Michael Collins physically assaulted a saboteur. This was followed by hunt master Olivia Forsyth purposely blocking the busy B4455 while she ranted and raved, before eventually being moved on by police.


What a great example to set for children.


It’s not just fox and hare hunting that indoctrinates children; they are exposed to animal cruelty at all blood sports. Just this weekend, at the Dove Valley Mink Hounds, children as young as 11 were present, with one as young as 14 carrying a T-bar and a shovel, ready and waiting to participate in the tormenting of mink and otters.


What a wonderful way to spend the summer holidays, learning how to terrorise and abuse the local wildlife.


As the UN states, children should be kept safe from witnessing all forms of violence, including that inflicted upon animals. What the above examples show are that children are not only witnessing this violence, they are active participants from a very young age, being taught that this is acceptable and being encouraged to be complicit in breaking the law.


The problem is the adults teaching them were subject to the same indoctrination and so a cycle has been formed. A cycle of barbaric violence and law breaking which is dressed up as ‘tradition.’ There are some things that should not be passed onto children and blood sports is one of them.

Hunt Saboteurs Association

title: Gökalp: The commune is the key to living together - Part One
content:
Suat Gökalp, who spent 33 years of his life in prison, began working to contribute to Abdullah Öcalan’s call for peace and a democratic society and his paradigm of communal society soon after regaining his freedom. Despite spending so many years under conditions of isolation, Gökalp speaks with a determination and clarity that leave little trace of the despair or anxiety often encountered outside prison. Drawing on his own life story, he spoke to ANF about conditions of isolation in prisons, the Peace and Democratic Society Process and the paradigm of communal society.


I grew up where the memory of resistance was kept alive


Suat Gökalp, 55, who describes himself as “a member of the Apo Movement,” said he has been involved in the Kurdish revolutionary struggle for 37 years. He joined the guerrillas at the age of 19 and was arrested in Istanbul in 1993, spending a total of 33 years in prison. Gökalp said he grew up in a highly politically conscious environment in central Ağrı. He said: “Ağrı itself represents an important current within the Kurdish struggle because of its history of resistance. I grew up in an environment where the memory of the Ağrı Rebellion and the resistance against the Zîlan massacre was kept alive. I spent my childhood in the Teyyare neighbourhood, which had a strong Kurdish and left-wing political consciousness, and that had a profound influence on my decision to join the struggle.”


The Kurdish people’s struggle and organised prison life kept me going


Gökalp said he left high school at the age of 19 to join the Kurdish freedom struggle. He said: “It was the 1990s, the period of the serhildan uprisings, and at the time, those who did not join the struggle were looked down upon and called opportunists. That sociopolitical climate also influenced our decision to join. People were joining in groups, one after another, during that period.” Gökalp joined the ranks of the Kurdish freedom movement without informing his family. After spending two years with the guerrillas, he was arrested in Istanbul in 1993, marking the beginning of 33 years of imprisonment. His years in prison took him through Sağmalcılar, Bayrampaşa, Ümraniye, Bursa, Kandıra and Bolu, much of that time marked by transfers and isolation. Gökalp said the sources that kept his ideological, philosophical and spiritual motivation alive in prison were both the struggle waged by the Kurdish people outside and the organised collective life maintained by prisoners. He explained that every moment of prison life was organised through collective activities, education and efforts to follow developments in the broader struggle and respond accordingly. Although physically imprisoned, he said, this allowed them to feel free in spirit.


F-Type prisons are like laboratories


Gökalp spent 18 of his 33 years of imprisonment under isolation conditions in F-Type prisons. He said: “We were the first group from our movement to be transferred to F-Type prisons. Together with our comrade Sabri Ok, 14 of us were transferred from Bursa to Kandıra F-Type Prison. I remained in F-Type prisons from late 2003 until October 2025.” Gökalp said the reality of isolation could never be fully understood without experiencing it first-hand: “We had previously read and studied how F-Type prisons were modelled on a policy used in Germany against the Red Army Faction (RAF) guerrillas. But there is a profound difference between reading about something, acquiring knowledge of it, and actually living through it. What we saw in F-Type prisons was an architecture designed to destroy the social and spiritual dimensions of a human being. From the soundproofing and the isolation of communication between cells to the paint that was used and the guards speaking exclusively in commands, we saw a prison system that had been deliberately designed down to the smallest detail. Resisting all of this required an organised, planned and disciplined stance. For us, resistance did not simply mean resisting physical attacks and torture. Resistance also meant preserving the social and spiritual dimensions of ourselves through the way we lived, while safeguarding our sociopolitical goals, our beliefs, our decisions and our motivation. Because ideology, too, is dynamic. Contrary to what people may think, it is not static. To use a metaphor, ideology is like a flower. If you water it, it stays alive; if you do not, it withers. If you do not renew and develop your ideological education every …

author: Unknown
title: Kalyon'un RES projesinde ÇED süreci tamamlandı: Orman, yaylak ve kuşların yaşam alanları türbinlerin gölgesinde
content:
Kalyon Holding’in Ordu, Tokat ve Sivas sınırlarında planladığı 33 türbinlik rüzgar enerji santralı (RES) projesinin nihai ÇED raporu, projenin orman ve yaylak alanları ile bölgedeki kuş türleri üzerindeki etkilerini ortaya koydu. Proje kapsamında yaylaklarda 29,1 hektarlık alanda inşaat yapılması planlanırken, türbinlerin kurulacağı orman alanlarında ağaç kesimi gündemde.

AKP iktidarı döneminde aldığı kamu ihaleleriyle bilinen Kalyon Holding’in Ordu, Tokat ve Sivas’ı kapsayan 33 türbinlik RES projesinde çevresel etki değerlendirmesi (ÇED) süreci tamamlandı. Bölge halkının itiraz ettiği projeye ilişkin nihai ÇED raporu yayımlandı.

Cumhuriyet’ten Şeyda Öztürk’ün haberine göre, rapora eklenen ekosistem değerlendirme raporunda 33 türbinin büyük bölümünün tarım ve mera alanlarında bulunduğu, 7 türbinin ise orman alanları üzerinde yer aldığı kaydedildi.

Orman Genel Müdürlüğünün (OGM) saha incelemesinde ise 11 türbinin “orman sayılan alanlarda” kaldığı belirtildi. ÇED raporundaki e-OGM arazi örtüsü tablosunda da 10 türbin “orman” niteliğinde gösterildi.

Böylece aynı nihai raporun farklı bölümlerinde orman alanlarıyla ilişkili türbinlerin sayısı 7, 10 ve 11 olarak sıralandı. Kullanılan arazi sınıflandırmalarının kapsamları farklılık gösterebilse de raporda söz konusu sayıların neden değiştiğine ilişkin ayrıca bir açıklamaya yer verilmedi.

OGM görüşündeki bir başka farklılık ise U27 numaralı türbine ilişkin oldu. “Orman sayılan alanlarda” bulunduğu belirtilen 11 türbin arasında U27 sayılmazken, raporun devamındaki değerlendirmede U17, U18 ve U27 türbinlerinin “verimli orman ve gençleştirme sahalarında” kaldığı ifade edildi.

OGM, bu üç türbinin süpürme alanlarında bulunan ağaçların korunmasını ve vinç montaj alanı dışında ağaç kesilmemesini istedi. ÇED raporunun “kesilecek ağaçların tür ve sayıları” bölümünde ise proje kapsamında toplam kaç ağacın kesileceği bilgisi yer almadı.

Tapu kayıtlarına göre, proje alanı ve çevresindeki yaylak vasıflı taşınmazların 1240 hektarlık bölümü proje sahasının içerisinde bulunuyor.

Yaylak alanlarının 18,3 hektarında türbinlerin, 8,6 hektarında yolların, 2,2 hektarında ise şalt merkezi ve depolama tesisinin yapılması planlanıyor. Böylece yaylaklarda toplam 29,1 hektarlık alanda inşaat öngörülüyor.

Proje sahasındaki kuşlara yönelik yapılan 2025 sonbahar izleme çalışmasında 63 kuş türü tespit edildi. Süzülerek uçan hedef türlerden 484 birey kaydedilirken, bunlardan 51’inin türbin kanatlarının döneceği süpürme bölgesinden geçtiği belirlendi.

Çalışmada, Uluslararası Doğayı Koruma Birliğinin (IUCN) “hassas” kategorisinde yer alan büyük orman kartalı ile “tehdide yakın” kategorisindeki kızılbaşlı örümcekkuşu da tespit edildi. Buna karşın ÇED raporunda bölgenin nesli tehlike altındaki kuşlar bakımından kritik bir göç güzergahı olmadığı değerlendirmesi yapıldı.

ÇED sürecinde bölge halkı da projeye itiraz etti. Sivas’ın Sugözü köyünde yaşayan yurttaşlar, daha önce hayata geçirilen HES, yol ve enerji iletim hattı yatırımlarının mera alanlarını daralttığını belirterek RES projesini istemediklerini dile getirdi.

Halkın katılımı toplantısına ilişkin tutanağa bir yurttaşın, “Biz bu projeyi istemiyoruz” sözleri yansırken, başka bir yurttaşın “Bizim geleceğimize bırakacağımız toprak kalmadı” ifadeleri de kayda geçti.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: DebConf 25
title: A retrieval-augmented-generation pipeline to help users query system-provided documentation
content:
by Gunnar Wolf


by Tzolkin GARDUNO ALVARADO


At: DebConf25


https://debconf25.debconf.org/talks/80-a-retrieval-augmented-generation-pipeline-to-help-users-query-system-provided-documentation/


The increasing integration of AI into computing workflows demands a re-evaluation of traditional operating system design. In environments like Debian, users are often faced with a vast ecosystem of command-line tools, each accompanied by extensive manual pages (man pages) detailing usage, flags, and parameters. While comprehensive, these documents are frequently dense, verbose, and not well-suited for rapid onboarding or targeted queries. We propose a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline to bridge this gap, enabling natural language interaction with system documentation. By combining tokenization, embedding, and dense retrieval with a language generation model, our system allows users to query tool usage in plain language and receive concise, contextually relevant responses. This approach streamlines tool discovery and comprehension, and represents a step toward more intelligent, user-aware operating systems.


Room: Petit amphi


Scheduled start: 2025-07-15 10:00:00+02:00

author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: Glacier Collapse: 2K Dead or Missing in Nepal-Tibet Flood Is "Glaring Example of Climate Injustice"
content:
We get a report from Nepal, where at least 547 people are confirmed to have died and over 1,500 are still missing after a glacial collapse on Wednesday sent a wall of ice, mud and rock into a Himalayan river, triggering catastrophic flooding in the Nepal-Tibet border region that swept away entire communities. Nepali authorities say they have rescued more than 3,700 people so far. Geologists say the flash floods were set off by a landslide and glacial avalanche so powerful it set off its own seismic signal. Climate scientists warn the region is warming much faster than the global average, leading to the rapid retreat of glaciers.


“Scientists and civil society have been warning about the very fact that these kind of events might happen in the Himalayas,” says Sunil Acharya, a climate and public policy specialist reporting from Kathmandu, Nepal. “This is the result of the delayed global action to deal with climate change.”


“The number of people being killed, the number of properties being damaged has been way beyond what we can adapt to,” says Acharya. The floods have “[washed] away hundreds of villages, a huge number of bridges and road infrastructure and also hydropower stations.”

author: winter oak
title: A cult both crazed and cruel
content:
by Paul Cudenec, who reads the article

here


The first thing that springs into your mind when I mention “Chabad Lubavitch” may be the strange affair of the secret tunnel or tunnels discovered under its base in New York in 2024.


But be careful not to partake of what

Newsweek


termed

 “frenzied speculation” about the peculiar behaviour of Chabad members and the sighting of a stained mattress. [1]


Jonathan Greenblatt, director of the Anti-Defamation League,

told


Rolling Stone

: “It’s deeply troubling that anyone would use this incident, which the Chabad movement at large has strongly condemned, to draw inappropriate and false comparisons to Hamas tunnels in Gaza or propagate age-old antisemitic conspiracy theories, such as Jews are involved in human trafficking or organ harvesting”. [2]


Given its relatively low profile, you might well assume that, whatever it is up to, Chabad is just a religious sect and plays no real and serious role on a world political stage presented to us as thoroughly secular.


If so, you are gravely mistaken, as Pierre Hillard expertly explains in his book

Comprendre l’empire loubavitch

 (‘Understanding the Lubavitch empire’).


He says that, in fact, the organisation wields global influence at the highest levels and is playing “an absolutely decisive role in the course of human history”. [3]


Hillard traces the Chabad story back to the time of Jesus who, from his own Christian perspective, was the Messiah whose coming had been predicted in biblical Judaism.


But he says that in the centuries before Jesus’s birth, Jewish religious commentary had been predicting “a warrior Messiah, not a suffering one, acting in the sole interests of the Jewish world, which would claim primacy over all the peoples of the earth”. [4]


“This misinterpretation of sacred texts led the Jewish elites, with some exceptions such as Nicodemus, not to recognise Christ as the logical fulfilment of all the prophetic announcements”. [5]


Subsequently, their Temple in Jerusalem was destroyed by the Romans and they were scattered around the place, whether in Rome, Alexandria or Babylon.


They were, of course, still waiting for the “real” Messiah, or

Moshiach

, to turn up and this was still the warrior version, not the suffering one.


In fact, explains Hillard, the roles are flipped in comparison to the Christian outlook. In Jewish teaching, it is not the Messiah who suffers for the people of the whole world, but the Jewish people who suffer in order to bring the Messiah who will give them control over the whole world.


Therefore, as the Israeli scholar Gershom Scholem set out, the Jewish idea of redemption is not beyond time, as Christians see it, but very physically part of history – specifically Jewish history. [6]


Hillard explains that in the early years of Christianity the rabbinical world found itself confronted with a new entity becoming increasingly important in the Roman empire, which was persuading not just pagans but also Jews to convert to its faith.


Faced with the prospect of their flock joining, and further strengthening, this rival religion, they put together two new books of rabbinic commentary aimed at seeing off the threat – the Jerusalem Talmud and the Babylonian Talmud.


“These texts were written between the first and the sixth centuries and constituted the religious, political and civil code of the rabbinic synagogue. Aimed at retaining the Jewish world, but also at persuading it to wait patiently for the Messiah, these two works are violently anti-Christian”. [7]


From a Talmudic perspective, Jesus had betrayed Moses’ teaching and was consequently condemned to boil for ever in excrement. [8]


Among countless Jewish sources, Hillard quotes rabbi Abraham Cohen’s description of the Talmudic judeo-supremacism that is at the heart of Chabad Lubavitch’s worldview.


“Nothing is more natural, in a literature composed by Jews for Jews, than the exceptional pre-eminence given to the people of Israel. The inhabitants of the world can effectively be divided between Israel and the other nations considered as one block.


“This is obviously a biblical doctrine, but the rabbis have amplified it infinitely. Everywhere the Talmud explicitly insists on the close and unique kinship that exists between God and His people.


“The relationship that unites Israel to God is so intimate that the way in which Israel is treated on earth has repercussions for God in heaven… ‘He who hates Israel is …

author: Miriam Lafontaine
title: Coast Guard spills 200 litres of fuel from vessel on Baker Lake
content:
A fuel spill reported in Baker Lake on Tuesday morning has resulted in residents temporarily being cut off from their water supply.


The Canadian Coast Guard reported the spill, which involved a sea vessel, to the territory’s environmental authorities just before 7 a.m. on Tuesday, according to coast guard’s report in the N.W.T. and Nunavut spill database.


Approximately 200 litres of petroleum fuel spilled in the lake just northwest of Christopher Island and impacted 1,500 square metres of the lake’s surface area, according to the database.

The cause of the spill is not yet known.


Nunavut’s Department of Transportation and Infrastructure informed residents about the spill on Wednesday through a public service announcement. 


The Department of Health ordered a temporary shut down of the community’s water treatment plant while authorities determined the seriousness of the spill. According to the public service announcement, drinking water access was restored after the department determined the water was safe to drink. 


That department will also continue to monitor the quality of water in the area, said the public service announcement.


There have been a number of spills in Baker Lake over the past several months. In April 2025, about 100 litres spilled after a fuel truck operator

fell asleep

 while filling his truck.


A

diesel spill in the hamlet

 in June was estimated to be between 600 and 1,000 litres.


Nunatsiaq News is still waiting on comment from the Canadian Coast Guard and Nunavut’s Department of Infrastructure to learn more about the incident.

author: By Devon Cupery, Contributor
title: Enbridge Line 5 Spills Natural Gas Liquids in Northern Wisconsin
content:
Saxon, WI — Enbridge’s aging

Line 5

 pipeline is spilling natural gas liquids in northern Wisconsin. The rupture occurred just east of the Bad River Reservation near Lake Superior on August 25, 2026. According to Enbridge, an unoccupied semi truck rolled into an excavation site and struck the pipeline.


The Canadian oil giant faces numerous legal challenges over its operation of Line 5. The 73-year-old pipeline carries oil and natural gas liquids through the heart of the Great Lakes region. Experts warn that it risks rupturing into the world’s largest bodies of freshwater.


Enbridge’s Line 5 pipeline

, originally routed across

Bad River Band

 tribal land under easements

dating to 1953

, is now being rerouted along a new 41.1-mile corridor through

1854 Treaty Territory

 in Ashland County, Wis., crossing 186 waterways, 612 acres of wetlands, and hard bedrock across the

Penokee-Gogebic Range

, the zone of greatest geological uncertainty along the route.


Line 5 alone has had roughly 30 on-land releases, totaling around one million gallons of oil.
