title: 3ήμερο δράσεων για τα 3 χρόνια από την κρατική δολοφονία του Κώστα Μανιουδάκη, 28-30/8
content:
ΓΙΑ ΤΩΡΑ, ΓΙΑ ΠΑΝΤΑ ΚΑΙ ΓΙΑ ΟΣΟ ΧΡΕΙΑΣΤΕΙ ΑΥΤΕΣ ΟΙ ΜΕΡΕΣ ΕΙΝΑΙ ΤΟΥ ΚΩΣΤΗ


>ΠΑΡΑΣΚΕΥΗ 28 ΑΥΓΟΥΣΤΟΥ


19:00, αυλή του κατειλημμένου λόφου Καστέλι


Εκδήλωση-συζήτηση: «Ο δικαστικός εμπαιγμός ως μέρος της συγκάλυψης της αστυνομικής βίας»


Ενημέρωση από τις υποθέσεις κρατικών δολοφονιών του Βασίλειου Μάγγου, του Μοχάμεντ Καμράν και του Κώστα Μανιουδάκη.


Στη συζήτηση θα συμμετέχουν ο Γιάννης Μάγγος, πατέρας του Βασίλειου, ο Αναστάσης Μανιουδάκης, γιος του Κωστή, ο Θανάσης Καμπαγιάννης, δικηγόρος στην υπόθεση δολοφονίας του Κωστή, καθώς και μέλος της ανοιχτής συνέλευσης ενάντια στην κρατική δολοφονία του Μοχαμεντ Καμράν.


Η εισήγηση της ανοιχτής συνέλευσης για την κρατική δολοφονία του Κ. Μανιουδάκη:


Εισήγηση της εκδήλωσης «Ο δικαστικός εμπαιγμός ως μέρος της συγκάλυψης της αστυνομικής βίας» | 3 χρόνια από την κρατική δολοφονία του Κώστα Μανιουδάκη, Παρασκευή 28/08


>ΣΑΒΒΑΤΟ 29 ΑΥΓΟΥΣΤΟΥ


20:00, πλατεία δημοτικής Αγοράς


ΠΟΡΕΙΑ για τα τρία χρόνια από την κρατική δολοφονία του Κώστα Μανιουδάκη


>ΚΥΡΙΑΚΗ 30 ΑΥΓΟΥΣΤΟΥ


12:00, επαρχιακός δρόμος Φρε-Βρυσών στην έξοδο προς τον ΒΟΑΚ, στο ύψος των Βρυσών


Συγκέντρωση μνήμης στο σημείο της δολοφονίας του Κωστή


Στο σημείο αυτό, η ανοιχτή συνέλευση και αλληλέγγυα άτομα έχουμε τοποθετήσει από τον Φεβρουάριο του 2024, επιγραφή που αναφέρει «Σε αυτήν την περιοχή, το απόγευμα της 1ης Σεπτεμβρίου του 2023, αστυνομικοί των Τ.Α.Ε. δολοφόνησαν σε “τυχαίο έλεγχο” τον Κωστή Μανιουδάκη. Ο αγώνας ενάντια στην αστυνομική ασυδοσία και την κρατική βαρβαρότητα είναι αγώνας για την αξιοπρέπεια. Και ας μην νικήσουμε ποτέ θα πολεμάμε πάντα για έναν άλλον ελεύθερο κόσμο» απεικονίζοντας τα σπασμένα γυαλιά του Κωστή που άφησαν πίσω οι βασανιστές του, μετά τον θανατηφόρο ξυλοδαρμό του.

title: Bakan Yumaklı'dan orman yangını uyarısı: Önümüzdeki 3 gün kritik
content:
Fotoğraf: İzmir Büyükşehir Belediyesi

Ankara – Tarım ve Orman Bakanı İbrahim Yumaklı, 28-30 Ağustos tarihlerinde Marmara, Ege ve Batı Akdeniz’de kuvvetli rüzgâr, yüksek sıcaklık ve düşük nem nedeniyle orman yangını riskinin artacağını belirterek vatandaşları dikkatli olmaları konusunda uyardı.

Yumaklı, sosyal medya hesabından yaptığı açıklamada, meteorolojik verilere göre önümüzdeki üç günün orman yangınları açısından kritik olduğunu bildirdi.

Marmara, Ege ve Batı Akdeniz’de beklenen hava koşullarının yangın riskini artıracağını belirten Yumaklı, ormanlık alanlarda ve yakın çevresinde ateş yakılmaması, kuru otluk alanlara yanıcı madde atılmaması, anız ve bahçe atığı yakılmaması uyarısında bulundu.

Yumaklı, en küçük duman veya şüpheli durumun 112 Acil Çağrı Merkezi’ne bildirilmesini isteyerek, “En büyük gücümüz vatandaşlarımızın duyarlılığı ile yangın çıkmasını önlemektir” dedi.

title: Foça'da "Barış ve Ekoloji" için belgesel film günleri başlıyor
content:
İzmir – Barışa her geçen gün daha fazla ihtiyaç duyulan günlerde Foça Barış Kadınları, 1 Eylül Barış gününde, ‘’Barış ve Ekoloji’’ temalı belgesel gösterimi ve söyleşiler düzenliyor.

Bu yıl 3. kez düzenlenecek olan etkinlikte, Şarap Rengi Deniz, Seva/Birlikte, Kaz Dağları Talanı ve Habap Çeşmeleri belgeselleri gösterilecek. Barış etkinliklerinde, geçtiğimiz Haziran ayında yaşama veda eden kadın, insan hakları ve barış savunucusu, Kıbrıslı gazeteci ve yazar Sevgül Uludağ ile cinayet sonucu hayatını kaybeden çevre savunucusu, bağımsız gazeteci, yönetmen Hakan Tosun anılacak.

Etkinliğin ilk gününde, çatışmalı ortamın sonucu büyük acıların yaşandığı Kıbrıs’ta, Türk-Rum ayırt etmeden kayıpların peşine düşen kadın, barış ve insan hakları savunucusu Sevgül Uludağ’ın hayatı ve mücadelesi anlatılacak. Barış ve birlikteliğe adadığı hayatından kesitler sunularak Kıbrıs’ta iki toplum arasında kardeşlik ve barışın kurulması çabalarına tanık olunacak.

Etkinlik Nefin Dinç’in yönetmenliğini yaptığı ve Marmara’dan Akdeniz’e uzanan kirliliği ve biyoçeşitliliğin yok oluşunu konu alan ‘’Şarap Rengi Deniz’’ ile devam edecek. Günün son gösterimi elli binden fazla can kaybının yaşandığı 6 Şubat depremi sonrası Antakya’da kadın, çocuk ve gençlerin dayanışmalarını, cesaret ve umut hikayelerini konu alan "Seva" belgeseli. Filmin ardından yönetmen Nesime Karateke ile bir söyleşi gerçekleştirilecek.

Etkinliğin ikinci gününde evine giderken öldürülen çevre savunucusu ve gazeteci Hakan Tosun’un çektiği ‘’Kaz Dağları Talanı’’ belgeseli gösteriminin ardından kardeşi Özlem Tosun ile bir söyleşi gerçekleşecek. Söyleşide, Hakan Tosun cinayeti ile ilgili dava süreci dinleyicilerle birlikte masaya yatırılacak.

Söyleşinin ardından, projesi Hrant Dink Vakfı ve Fethiye Çetin'e ait olan, yönetmenliğini Dilek Aydın’ın üstlendiği, Habap Çeşmeleri belgeseli izleyiciyle buluşacak. Belgesel, Fethiye Çetin’in bir sırrını ve şimdiki adı Ekinözü olan Habap köyünde restorasyonu yapılan çeşmelerin hikayesini anlatıyor.

İzleyicilerle buluşacak belgeseller:

Yönetmen Nefin Dinç'in, kendine özgü sade ve çarpıcı anlatımıyla Marmara Deniz'inden Akdeniz'e uzanan kirliliğe, Akdeniz'deki biyoçeşitliliğin yok oluşuna odaklanan uluslararası ödüllü belgeseli.

Yönetmenliğini Nesime Karateke'nin üstlendiği, 6 Şubat 2023 depremlerinin ardından Antakya'da yaşanan yıkımı, yas sürecini ve dayanışmayla yeniden filizlenen hayatı konu alıyor.

Dünyanın en yüksek oksijen oranına sahip bölgelerinden biri olan Kaz Dağları'nın, ekonomik rant, madencilik faaliyetleri ve altın-bakır arama projeleri uğruna uğradığı büyük ekolojik yıkımı ve buna karşı yürütülen toplumsal direnişi konu alıyor.

Elazığ'ın Kovancılar ilçesindeki 400 yıllık tarihi çeşmelerin onarımı ve hatırlama süreci... Fethiye Çetin'in “Anneannem” adlı kitabında çocukluk anılarını anlattığı, kökle ve geçmişteki yaşamla doğrudan bağ kurmasını ele alıyor. Habap köyünde ailesiyle yaşayan mutlu bir kız çocuğu olan Heranuş’un isminin Seher’e, köyünün ise Ekinözü’ne dönüşmesini aktarıyor.

Etkinlikler 1–2 Eylül 2026 tarihlerinde, saat 19:00'da Foça Reha Midilli Kültür Merkezi'nde ücretsiz olarak gerçekleştirilecek.

title: Comunicado de amigos, familiares, lov y comunidades de los Presos Políticos Mapuche de Caso Grollmus de la Franja Lavkenche
content:
«COMUNICADO PÚBLICO


Lavken mapu, Pukem 2026.


Mari mari kom pu che, pu ke lov, pu ke mapu, eymun kom!

Tras reunirnos en txawün el día de hoy queremos dirigirinos a nuestro pueblo, a la opinión pública nacional e internacional, a la ocupación chilena en nuestro territorio.

19 de nuestros hermanos, compañeros, padre e hijos se encuentra ad portas de terminar su juicio oral, imputados todos por su supuesta participación en el atentado al Molino Grollmus. Lo vamos a decir de forma clara y sin metáforas, nuestros presos políticos son víctimas de la necesidad ansiosa del ministerio público por dar resultados al sistema político y a los colonos que ocupan nuestro territorio. Ellos no estan presos por ser delincuentes, sino, porque la unica forma que ha encontrado la ocupación para detener la justa y legitima lucha por el territorio y autonomía de los mapuche ha sido la persecución, los allanamientos, los desalojos, la prisión. Nuestros presos se encuentran en esa condición pues todos ellos se organizaron a lo largo y ancho de nuestro territorio para luchar por la recuperación de sus tierras, por levantar sus ngillatun, por dar dignidad a su gente.

El fiscal de la causa se encuentra con una querella en su contra por prevaricacion, los colonos Grollmus se juntaron directamente con el presidente Jose Kast, y el Ministro Arrau a definido públicamente este juicio como «trascendental para Chile». Durante el transcurso de las audiencias ha quedado en plena evidencia que el unico insumo de fiscalia es la declaración de personas sin nombre y rostro, nada más.

La situación es clara, nuestros hermanos, dignos y perseguidos, arriegan cadena perpetua solo por la inmesa presión del poder político para su encarcelamiento.

Hoy son los alegatos de clausura y declaramos que nuestros esfuerzos seran inclaudicables en búsqueda de justicia.

title: Organizaciones populares repudian la privatización de Aysa frente al Ministerio de Economía
content:
Hoy, pese a la lluvia, representantes de organizaciones sociales, ambientales, vecinales, sindicatos y partidos se presentaron ante el Ministerio de Economía de la Nación para hacer entrega de una carta dirigida al ministro de Economía, Luis Andrés Caputo, expresando su rechazo al proceso de privatización de Agua y Saneamientos Argentinos (AySA).

Por Patricia Rodríguez para ANRed


En la presentación expusieron su rechazo al proceso de privatización. Empezando por la modificación del Marco Regulatorio (Dec. 493/25) que suprimió el Derecho Humano al Agua para habilitar los cortes del servicio en caso de dificultades de pago y bajo los estándares de control de calidad del agua, con los posibles impactos en la salud que esto puede significar. La privatización de AySA pone en discusión el futuro de un servicio esencial para millones de personas y puede tener consecuencias directas sobre las tarifas, la expansión de la infraestructura, el mantenimiento de las redes, los mecanismos de control y la calidad del agua y el saneamiento.


La carta presentada denuncia que se pretende volver a convertir el agua en una mercancía. La nefasta experiencia de la privatización de los años 90, significó tarifas dolarizadas impagables, incumplimiento reiterado de metas de expansión del servicio, creciente endeudamiento para fugar capitales, todos hechos que padecimos como pueblo en nuestros territorios. Esa experiencia privatizadora fracasada no puede volver a ocurrir.


Hoy en el nuevo contrato de concesión previsto para la empresa se le asegura rentas extraordinarias al futuro operador y cero riesgo empresario, al calcular una tasa de ganancia de la empresa en dólares. «Denunciamos que los usuarios deberán pagar una renta anual en dólares del 8,9% sobre la operación y expansión del servicio» expresaron.


Asimismo denuncian que el proceso de licitación en curso mantiene un secretismo injustificado ni siquiera el Ente Regulador conoce los contenidos exigidos en los pliegos de licitación. Esto atenta contra todo principio de transparencia y rendición de cuentas de la Administración Pública.


Reclamaron al gobierno que cumpla con la cautelar dictada en el juzgado de Primera Instancia en los Contencioso Administrativo N° 2 de La Plata, que suspendió el proceso de privatización, obligando al Ejecutivo Nacional a que abstenerse de modificar los parámetros de control de calidad de agua, reducción de exigencias regulatorias y postergación de planes de obras críticas. Debe suspenderse el proceso de privatización y se deben reactivar las obras públicas de saneamiento.


«Le informamos al Ministerio de Economía que no vamos a aceptar un nuevo saqueo y que los responsables de esta entrega son pasibles de ser juzgados por fraude en perjuicio de la Administración Pública» afirmaron.


Agregaron «desde nuestros espacios entendemos que el retraso en la apertura de los pliegos constituye, en este contexto, una oportunidad. Este tiempo adicional nos permite profundizar el trabajo conjunto, articular con nuevas organizaciones y sectores y unir las distintas luchas que se vienen desarrollando en defensa del agua, el ambiente, la salud, el trabajo y los servicios públicos».


En la asamblea las organizaciones consideraron urgente fortalecer la organización y ampliar la participación para masificar el repudio a la entrega del patrimonio nacional.


«La experiencia de nuestro territorio demuestra que los avances en materia de agua y saneamiento fueron posibles gracias a años de organización, lucha vecinal, trabajo comunitario y participación de distintos sectores. Por eso entendemos que, frente al actual proceso de privatización, la construcción de una respuesta colectiva resulta fundamental» recordaron.


Entre las organizaciones presentes estuvieron:

author: Sharon Zhang
title: Jury Finds DeSantis Admin Diverted $10M Marked for Poor Children to GOP Coffers
content:
The funds were given to Florida from a settlement with a company that was overcharging Medicaid for prescription drugs.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

A Florida grand jury has found that Republican Gov. Ron DeSantis’s administration misappropriated millions of dollars in taxpayer funds that were marked to help children get health insurance but instead went to right-wing political groups and the state Republican Party.

The grand jury found that state officials funneled $10 million in funding from a Medicaid-related settlement to the Hope Florida Foundation, a faith-based organization which was supposed to use the funding to help poor children with health coverage, according to reporting by CBS Miami.

But the charity, founded by DeSantis’s wife, quickly funnelled half of the money to the right-wing group Secure Florida’s Future, and the other half to Save Our Society From Drugs in 2024. The funding was ultimately used to help defeat a citizen’s ballot measure, Amendment 3, which would have legalized recreational marijuana in the state.

The grand jury concluded that there is not sufficient evidence to charge anyone criminally because “nobody will take responsibility” for the decision to send the money to Hope Florida or “had any memory of who made it.”

The money originated from a multi-state settlement with for-profit health care company Centene, which agreed to pay a $1 billion settlement in 2021 for allegedly overcharging numerous state Medicaid programs for prescription drugs. As many other states settled their cases, DeSantis’s administration ignored Centene’s request to resolve the matter, reports said, but finally agreed to accept the $67 million in 2024. The state decided that $57 million would be returned to taxpayers while the rest would go to Hope Florida, apparently bypassing the state legislature to make that decision.

The decision to give the money to Hope Florida was already highly controversial at the time, with detractors noting that it was DeSantis’s wife’s charity.

But the grand jury said they were told Hope Florida was chosen as a recipient because it “was compensation for ripping off sick poor children and Hope Florida’s mission and work aligned with the purpose of serving needy children with health issues.” In reality, the charity’s operations were a black box, and any plausible reasoning for the decision “was rendered moot by the fact that the money only stayed in Hope Florida’s account for a couple of days.”

DeSantis said on Thursday that the grand jury’s findings were a “lie” and that whoever leaked a copy of the report committed a “crime.” The day before, he said that he “wasn’t involved in the settlement agreement, but I’m very happy with how everything was done.”

News of the findings comes as the Trump administration has whipped up a frenzy about supposed fraud with regard to states’ disbursements of Medicaid — a campaign that the administration then used to withhold funding from Medicaid funds from the Democratically-controlled states of California and Minnesota.

author: Chris Walker
title: Trump Signs Executive Order Renaming Lake Ontario to “Lake America”
content:
The president also indicated he may try to “rename” either the Pacific or Atlantic oceans — or, possibly both of them.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

Amid an ongoing trade war with Canada, President Donald Trump issued an executive order on Thursday renaming Lake Ontario to “Lake America,” despite the fact that a majority of its surface area resides within Canadian territory.

Trump’s executive order did not discuss the breakdown of trade negotiations. Instead, the order, titled “Honoring the American History of the Great Lakes and Renaming Lake Ontario as Lake America,” claimed the president was changing the lake’s name to “to recognize the extraordinary contributions of the American people and the rich heritage of our history by naming great natural landmarks for our shared achievements.”

The order also stated that the U.S. is the “greatest protector of the Great Lakes, including the body of water currently known as Lake Ontario” — despite Trump administration policies that threaten the safety and cleanliness of the lakes.

The order requires the Interior Department to “rename as ‘Lake America’ the body of water currently named as Lake Ontario” in all official map-related government documents, “including on executive department and agency maps, contracts, and other documents and communications.” Although social media posts from the administration after Trump signed the order indicated it would become “effective immediately,” the department’s actions may take up to a calendar month to complete.

EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY: Lake Ontario is renamed to LAKE AMERICA! 🇺🇸 pic.twitter.com/ZFww8PexiW

The change only affects government maps in the U.S. As an international body of water, Canada is not compelled to change the name of the lake, and is likely to continue calling it Lake Ontario. Other countries could decide whether to recognize the name change.

Trump also indicated he may not be done renaming large bodies of water, and indicated that he may look at “changing” the names of oceans next.

“If you think about it, we have a gulf and we have a lake,” Trump said during the signing ceremony, referring also to his changing the name of the Gulf of Mexico to the “Gulf of America” in U.S. documents. “Now, all we need is an ocean. So maybe we’ll have to change the name of the Atlantic and/or the Pacific. Maybe we’ll change them.”

Trump says he might change the names of the Atlantic and Pacific Oceans next pic.twitter.com/460MysiWKa

The name change could affect more than just relations with Canada. Like the Gulf, Trump could try to punish entities that kept the old name intact — including news organizations — as the White House sought to restrict the press credentials of The Associated Press after it wouldn’t change its style guide last year.

“This is stupid bullshit but extremely pernicious stupid bullshit that reporters and news outlets can be penalized for failing to respect,” Matthew Gertz, senior fellow at Media Matters for America, said in a post on Bluesky.

Sen. Bernie Sanders (I-Vermont), whose home state borders Canada, also criticized the action as a distraction from real issues Americans are worried about.

“The American people don’t want to rename Lake Ontario Lake America. They want affordable healthcare, childcare, housing, education & nutrition assistance — all of which you have massively cut in order to pay for your $1 trillion tax break to the top 1%,” Sanders wrote on X, directing his post toward Trump himself.

As Trump toyed with the idea last week, Chief Margaret Sault of the Mississaugas of the Credit First Nation condemned the proposed change, noting that the name preceded the arrival of European colonizers to the continent.

“Lake Ontario has existed for thousands of years, long before Canada and the United States became the countries we know today. … You can change a label on a map, but you cannot change the relationship that our people have with these lands and waters,” Sault said. “You cannot rename away our history.”

title: YPJ announces the death of three fighters who fell during Afrin resistance in 2018
content:
The General Command of the Women’s Protection Units (YPJ) issued a written statement announcing the martyrdom of three of their fighters.


According to the statement, Êlêm Cûdî, Slava Kurdistan, and Êlêm Çiya fought until their last breaths in Afrin in 2018 to defend their land and the dignity of their people.


The YPJ obituary on Thursday includes the following:


"We are living through a historic period in which every inch of our land is safeguarded by the blood of the heroes of our freedom. Throughout history, women have led and contributed to great achievements, engraving their names in our movement in letters of gold. Today, the pioneering role of women freedom fighters has become an enduring reality. Our comrades Êlêm Cûdî, Slava Kurdistan, and Êlêm Çiya struggled until their last breaths to defend our land and the dignity of our people, attaining martyrdom at different times and in different places. We extend our deepest condolences to the architect of free life, Leader Apo (Abdullah Öcalan), to the families of our esteemed comrades, and to all members of our freedom-loving people.


In the struggle for freedom, every comrade who joins the ranks of resistance leaves her mark on the history of our people through determination and perseverance.


Our comrade Êlêm Cûdî was among those immortal heroines who advanced to the front lines with unwavering determination. She was raised in a patriotic family and was deeply imbued with the culture and values of her homeland. She believed that defending Afrin meant defending the dignity of humanity. Inspired by the spirit of sacrifice embodied by her comrades, she became a symbol of resistance, standing with an iron will in the face of the invaders’ most advanced technologies. Through her commitment to the struggle and her courage, Comrade Êlêm Cûdî secured a place in the hearts of all her comrades, giving those around her strength and courage during the most difficult times. She was not merely a fighter; she was also a defender of the values of freedom, equality, and a dignified life. Her struggle against oppression and darkness became a beacon illuminating our path of resistance. Comrade Êlêm Cûdî joined the caravan of immortals in an airstrike carried out by the occupying Turkish state on the Mabata area of Afrin on 14 March 2018.


In the Kurdish people’s struggle for freedom, the resistance of Afrin became a symbol of the struggle for existence and dignity against fascism and occupation. Within this steadfast stronghold of resistance, our comrade Êlêm Çiya, through her sacrifice and intellectual awareness, inscribed her name upon the rocks of Mount Kurmênc as a symbol of Apo’s struggle. Comrade Êlêm embraced freedom as a philosophy of life and social renewal, walking in the spirit of the free woman and democratic society. During the most difficult moments of the invading Turkish army’s attacks, her faith in the importance of defending the sacred land grew stronger, and she adopted an unwavering stance of sacrifice. Raised on the land of Afrin and deeply rooted in its rich culture of resistance, she made national values the foundation of her life of struggle. Her martyrdom became the beginning of a growing struggle for retribution. Our comrade Êlêm Çiya joined the caravan of martyrs during the resistance of Afrin in February 2018.


There is no doubt that the resistance of Afrin in 2018 stands among the most glorious and honorable chapters of this history. Our heroic comrade Slava Kurdistan was among the immortal, shining stars of that resistance. Comrade Slava was a steadfast woman, deeply devoted to the land of Afrin, dedicating every moment of her life to the freedom of her people and the dignity of women. She refused to accept occupation and slavery. When it came to defending the dignity of Afrin, she confronted the most brutal forms of violence with an iron will, a mind guided by freedom, and a self-sacrificing heart. Comrade Slava Kurdistan joined the caravan of immortals on the sacred land of Afrin, demonstrating through her martyrdom that the will of free women and the Kurdish people’s longing for freedom can be realized through struggle. Her life has become an example and an inspiration to thousands of young people who follow in her footsteps today. Our comrade Slava Kurdistan joined the caravan of martyrs in an airstrike carried out by the occupying Turkish state on 9 March 2018 on the village of Kafr Safri, in the district of Jindires, in the Afrin region …

title: Meeting in Damascus proposes integration of the YPJ as a distinct and organized force
content:
On 26 August, the General Command of the Women’s Protection Units (YPJ) held a meeting with an official delegation from the Ministry of Interior of the transitional government in Damascus.


During the meeting, issues of security and stability in Syria, as well as the future of cooperation and coordination between the two sides, were discussed extensively.


The future of the Women’s Protection Units (YPJ) was the main focus of the meeting. It was emphasized that the YPJ could be integrated, as a distinct and organized force, into the structure of the Ministry of Interior.


“The meeting was held in a positive and constructive atmosphere. In order to complete and finalize the integration process within the framework of the 29 January 2026 Agreement, our meetings and discussions will continue,” the YPJ General Command stated.

author: Unknown
title: IRGC shelling causes wildfire in Shaho protected area
content:
The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) has shelled protected areas of Shaho Mountain in Kamyaran County, Kurdistan Province, causing a widespread wildfire that remains active.


The Kurdistan Human Rights Network (KHRN) has reported that in recent days, IRGC forces told residents of villages around the mountain that access to the area would be prohibited for several days.


The forces then shelled the mountain, setting fire to a large part of the protected area.


Videos received by KHRN show the extent of the wildfire. IRGC forces have prevented environmental activists and local residents from entering the area to contain the blaze.


The Shaho and Kusalan protected area covers 57,236 hectares between the cities of Sarvabad, Ravansar, Paveh, Marivan and Kamyaran, near the border with the Kurdistan Region of Iraq.


It was designated a protected area under the management of Iran’s Department of Environment in 2009, pursuant to Resolution 303 of the Supreme Council for the Environment.


Environmental activists said the IRGC had built several military bases in the protected area since 2007, under the pretext of countering the presence of forces affiliated with Kurdish opposition parties.


Large parts of the area catch fire each year during security exercises.


Despite protests by environmental activists, extensive areas of pasture and forest have been destroyed during the construction of military bases and roads.


IRGC forces also deliberately set fire each year to pastures and forests around military installations, claiming this is intended to “prevent Kurdish opposition party forces from using vegetation cover to carry out attacks.”

author: Unknown
title: Memorial ceremony for three YPJ fighters in Heseke
content:
A solemn memorial ceremony was held in the city of Heseke in honor of three women fighters of the Women’s Protection Units (YPJ), who sacrificed their lives and wrote the highest meanings of heroism with their blood.


The symbolic funeral ceremony was organized to honor Silava Kurdistan (Îman Mihemed Mustefa), who fell on March 9, 2018; Eylem Cûdî (Fatma Mihemed Mustefa), who fell on March 14, 2018; and Eylem Çiya (Ranya Ferîd Ehmed), who fell during the resistance in Afrin in February 2018.


Hundreds of local residents and community dignitaries gathered at the Martyr Dijwar Cemetery.


The ceremony began with a solemn moment of silence in tribute to the women martyrs who have left us, while their memory remains forever alive in the conscience of the homeland.


At the conclusion of this moving ceremony, the Council of Martyrs’ Families came forward to read the martyrs’ commemorative documents. The documents were read in heartfelt words that reflected the depth of the loss and the greatness of their sacrifice, before being presented to the families of the women martyrs in a scene where tears of farewell mingled with pride and belonging.


This ceremony was an unforgettable tribute of loyalty, affirming that the sacrifices of these women fighters will remain a beacon for future generations and a symbol of heroism that will never fade.

author: Sharon Zhang
title: Oz Dismisses Measles Concerns as “Inappropriate” After Baby Dies in Pennsylvania
content:
“I don’t want anyone in America concerned inappropriately” about the surging disease, the health official said.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

Medicare and Medicaid Services administrator Mehmet Oz downplayed the GOP-fueled surge in measles infections after Pennsylvania officials announced that a newborn baby died with complications related to the disease this week.

On Wednesday, the Pennsylvania Department of Health revealed that one of the two measles-related deaths in Lancaster County this week was of a newborn baby. Both individuals were unvaccinated, and their deaths marked the first recorded deaths related to measles this year in the U.S.

Measles cases have risen to over 2,700 so far this year, the highest level in decades. The disease had been declared eliminated in the U.S. in 2000 due mostly to the effective measles, mumps, and rubella (MMR) vaccination program. Disinformation about vaccines spread by the Trump administration and Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. is driving the rise in measles cases, according to experts.

Trump administration official Mehmet Oz claimed, however, that the fears of measles are overblown.

“I don’t want anyone in America concerned inappropriately” about the disease, said Oz on Fox News. “We don’t know exactly what happened in Pennsylvania yet. We don’t know if the children died from measles or they had another condition that was already attacking them and they happened to get measles at the same time.”

Oz said that this is a common practice when attributing deaths related to COVID-19 during the pandemic — when many people died from pneumonia infections that were worsened by and often outright brought on by COVID infections.

This is a highly misleading comment. In announcing the deaths, Pennsylvania officials specified that the deaths were “associated” with measles. The county coroner found that the baby died from laceration of the spleen — which Children’s Hospital of Pennsylvania pediatrician and vaccine safety expert Paul Offit said can be a side effect of a measles infection. Offit told the Philadelphia Inquirer that measles can cause the spleen to be enlarged, and that birth can cause the spleen to rupture.

The coroner, Stephen Diamantoni, said that the pathologist who conducted the autopsy “did not feel it was related to measles.”

Offit said that the coroner should give another explanation for the spleen rupture if it weren’t caused by measles, and further said he has had conversations with state health officials that made it clear that the “patients would not have died were it not for measles.” He added that attributing deaths to something other than measles is a common tactic of anti-vaccine advocates like those in the Trump administration.

After the deaths, Kennedy claimed, without evidence, that Pennsylvania officials announced the deaths for political reasons. He even went as far to say that “deaths may even have been altogether fabricated by one of [Gov. Josh Shapiro’s] hopeful staffers.”

Pennsylvania Health Secretary Debra Bogen said that Kennedy’s statements are untrue, and that the deaths were announced after thorough investigation to verify that both patients were infected with measles — a highly contagious and dangerous illness that had an 11 percent hospitalization rate in 2025, and a 7 percent rate in the U.S.

Of measles patients this year, 93 percent are unvaccinated or their vaccination status is unknown. Most of these cases have been among children, who are the worst affected by the disease.

The measles outbreak may soon get worse. Earlier this month, President Donald Trump signed an executive order to recommend that the MMR vaccine be split into three separate shots, citing an old, thoroughly debunked claim that the vaccine causes autism. Health experts say that this may reduce uptake of vaccinations against measles, as new vaccines would have to be developed, and splitting them up may further discourage families from trusting the shot.

Amid this move, The New York Times resurfaced a claim made by Kennedy in remarks to a large crowd in Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, in 2021. At that event, he joked that his childhood measles infection allowed him to “stay home and watch TV the whole week.”

“The cure for measles is chicken soup and vitamin A,” he said, in a complete lie.
